entries.title: Can You Stop the Polar Bear Before It Kills the Activists?
entries.intro: These activists just freed a polar bear. Can we shoot it in time to save them, and how will they react?
entries.watchFor: The bear, when the shots land, which activists remain alive, and how the crowd responds.
entries.summary: Online gameplay sources for the polar-bear encounter. Switch shots to compare intervention with the normal release.
entries.coverage: The shooting clip begins after the bear leaves the cage. It supports stopping the roadside attack, but does not establish that every activist survived the entire encounter.

videos.label: Shoot the bear: activists react
videos.creator: Andy0209_ (X post)
videos.watchFor: 0:00: the bear is beside the activists. Around 0:02: shots hit the bear. Watch the collapse and the surviving activists confronting the player.
videos.summary: Unchanged hosted copy of the 60-second source posted by Andy0209_. The player shoots the bear beside the activists; the bear collapses and the crowd confronts the player. Original Spanish subtitles and game HUD remain. No added titles, captions, or voiceover.
videos.coverage: Visually reviewed. The clip starts with the bear already outside the truck and the roadside activists still standing. It does not show the cage opening or rule out an earlier casualty inside the truck. This is one recorded outcome, not proof that all activists can be saved.

videos.label: Comparison: normal bear release
videos.creator: GTA Academy
videos.watchFor: Use this source for the release setup and normal outcome. Compare it with the shooting clip, which starts after the bear is out.
videos.summary: GTA Academy: What Happens When You Free the Polar Bear in GTA VI? The uploader describes this as original gameplay of freeing the bear and the event reaching the in-game news.
videos.coverage: Comparison footage only. The source listing and description were checked; this is not a verified shooting-before-attack test and is not a second independent intervention attempt.

entries.title: Can a Dog Rescue You on a Jet Ski?
entries.intro: We're stranded at sea. Can a dog on a jet ski actually rescue us?
entries.watchFor: The dog's arrival, boarding, ride, and arrival at the beach.
entries.summary: Continuous original source 00:00 to 01:08. Swimming, rescue, boarding, ride and beach arrival. No added editorial text. Source watermark, game HUD, subtitles and audio remain.
entries.coverage: Shows the rescue, not a controlled spawn-timing test. Puppy Island exploration is separate entry 106.

entries.title: Can You Unlock a Secret First-Person Mode?
entries.intro: Can a phone-camera trick lock the game into first person? Let's watch it outside the car.
entries.watchFor: The camera settings, phone trick, first-person walking, and driving.
entries.summary: Controller-camera settings, phone and first-person car view, followed by 40 seconds of first-person walking and driving. No added text overlays or presenter shots. First 11 seconds silent; original game audio follows.
entries.coverage: Demonstrates the phone-camera route, not the taser method in the original setup. The source obscures part of the button sequence. Launch-version capture; a later patch may differ.
